caption: Piombino promontory and fortress, Piombino
composition: Fortified promontory town above the Tyrrhenian channel with Elba on the horizon · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From an elevated viewpoint offshore, the camera takes in the fortified town of Piombino crowning its rocky promontory at the left in the bright 14:08 afternoon sun. The terracotta rooftops and the massive bastion walls of the fortress stand out against the green hillside, waves breaking on the dark rocks below. The vast blue Tyrrhenian channel fills the right of the frame, with the long silhouette of Elba on the horizon under a clear sky.
